name: Zoomies
description: Zoomies is a lightweight, self-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet controller. It authenticates with a GitHub App, scales ephemeral runners from webhooks, and runs as a single Go binary with SQLite and no Kubernetes.

app_vars.name: var_zoomies_url
app_vars.label: External URL
app_vars.help: How GitHub and your browser reach Zoomies, e.g. https://zoomies.example.com. Defaults to http://<container-ip>:8080

app_vars.name: var_zoomies_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: Password for the admin account, at least 12 characters. Generated when left empty

notes.text: The admin password is shown at the end of the installation.
Connect GitHub from the Installations page after signing in; Zoomies creates the GitHub App for you.
Without a public https external URL GitHub cannot deliver webhooks, so Zoomies falls back to polling and picks up jobs tens of seconds later. Put a TLS reverse proxy in front for instant scaling.
Runners are Docker containers inside this LXC, which needs nesting and keyctl enabled.
